icon_transform_contract.scope: five hero weapon icons and three active stat-only gear icons, with two historical removed families retained; 32/48/64/96/256 variants
icon_transform_contract.orientation: Bow ONLY: directed string-to-grip firing axis -135 screen degrees (up-left), perpendicular to its string, per user clarification. Other weapon axes remain -45 degrees (up-right); approved axe retains this direction. Helmet, armor and boots remain authored upright (zero rotation). Explicit shaft/firing axes govern asymmetric weapons; alpha PCA is a separate diagnostic. Historical glove/amulet art retains its previous orientation.
icon_transform_contract.padding: latest Canvas gear/weapons retain reviewed authored fit and independent native renders at each size; unchanged legacy sword/historical raster fits reserve at least8% per side
icon_transform_contract.preservation: latest silver gear and bow/staff/katana installed by user request; original sword, approved clean axe and all soldier sprites retained. Stat-only gear never changes the cat costume.
